resources.string: Separate spaces for your apps, accounts, and files
Each space has its own apps, accounts, files, and screen lock. Set its PIN or password here before opening it to finish setup.
Set a PIN or password before managing spaces
Set a PIN or password before opening this space
Remove “%1$s”? Its apps, accounts, and files will be deleted.
Enter a name for the space
The space could not be updated. Check your screen lock and user restrictions, then try again.
Erase device keys with a separate PIN or password
A duress PIN or password destroys this phone’s encryption keys and shuts down the phone. Normal credentials take priority. Keep backups of data you need.
Entering either credential on the lockscreen permanently erases access to all device data. Choose credentials different from your normal screen locks. Both must contain at least four characters.
Check the credential lengths and confirmation entries
Configuration could not be verified. Confirm the owner and try again.
Set a different screen lock using the same type as your personal screen lock, then confirm your personal screen lock. Afterward, you can add a fingerprint to open this space.
Unlock protected data to continue moving storage
Screen lock is set. Add a fingerprint to open this space. Its screen lock is still required after a restart.
Unlock the space with its screen lock to continue fingerprint setup
